pattern: /design-critique on the agent's own preview tab -> three widths, both appearances, contrast measured, tree read, tab restored, screenshots in the report
experience: WI-2.21 acceptance: a critique must produce findings with screenshots at three widths and accessibility issues, using T3's preview rather than a Playwright script.
rule: skills/design-critique/SKILL.md: capture phone, tablet and desktop widths with preview_resize and preview_snapshot (save), check dark and light, measure contrast with preview_evaluate, read the accessibility tree, put the tab back, and report findings with the three screenshots.

pattern: /design-critique while the user drives the preview tab -> own tab on the same page, never resize the user's tab
experience: Resizing and re-theming the tab the user is looking at takes their screen away mid-review; the skill says to open the agent's own tab on the same page.
rule: skills/design-critique/SKILL.md: The user is driving it: open your own tab on the same page with preview_open and reuseExistingTab: false. Never resize a tab the user is driving.

pattern: /design-critique of a billing page that redirects to sign-in -> say so and ask for a way in; no critique of the gate or of source code
experience: Kiro Crew's design-critique skill was written after critiques of a login wall stood in for the screens behind it; the ported seeing rule must hold on T3's preview.
rule: skills/design-critique/SKILL.md: If the page is blank, an error page, a loading skeleton, or a login or setup wall, stop and say so. Ask for a way in. Never critique a gate as if it were the page, and never critique from source code alone.
